$description: NHIS — NASTRA Human Interface System design tokens. Single source of truth. Three layers: primitive (raw values, never used for meaning), semantic (meaning-bearing aliases components consume), component (constrained local tuning). Format: W3C DTCG-style ($value/$type, {alias}); NHIS provenance lives in $extensions.nhis. Generated outputs: tokens/css/nhis-tokens.css, tokens/types/tokens.ts (run `npm run tokens`). Theme: one dark operational Station theme (design decision NHIS-THEME-001). EVA tokens are expressed in visual angle, not CSS px.

nhis.evidenceFlags: P = read in primary source; S = second-hand; D = derived for NHIS; U = contains a figure not verified in a primary source. Copied from 01_NHIS_OPERATIONAL_UX_STANDARDS.md.

primitive.$description: Raw values. Product components must not reference these directly.

neutral.$description: Near-neutral ramp with a slight cool cast (OKLCH hue 255, chroma ≤ 0.012). Chroma kept low so neutrals never read as Advisory blue.

tint.$description: 12% fill over panel. Lower than the other tints because yellow is far lighter; keeps Caution calm and text contrast high.

eva.$description: OKLCH 0.86 0.21 145. EVA text/symbology colour only (NHIS B22). Not a Station status colour.

sans.$value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
sans.$description: Braille Institute, SIL OFL 1.1. Chosen for character disambiguation (NHIS A22). Fallbacks are system sans faces; they do not guarantee the same I/l/1 distinction.

mono.$value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Braille Institute, SIL OFL 1.1. Fixed-width with slashed zero and serifed I / tailed l. Used for numeric and tabular data only (NHIS A22; 03 §7).

100.$description: 10.5 pt. Tertiary metadata only. Above the 9 pt floor (NHIS A21).

200.$description: 12 pt. Minimum for important content and labels (NHIS A21).

surface.$description: Restrained surface model (03 §10). Depth comes from luminance steps and borders, never blur or glow.

raised.$description: Controls, cards and hover surfaces inside a panel.

scrim.$description: Behind modal dialogs. 80% canvas-black; content behind stays dimly visible for orientation.

primary.$description: Body, telemetry values, alert text. ≥ 14:1 on canvas/panel/raised; designed toward NASA's preferred 10:1 (NHIS A19).

muted.$description: Tertiary metadata. ≥ 6:1 on every surface (NASA 6:1 minimum). Never used for telemetry values.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only. Never used for stale data (03 §20).

inverse.$description: Text on light fills (primary action, Caution fill).

onAlert.$description: Text on red, blue and violet fills.

subtle.$description: Dividers and panel edges. Decorative grouping only; carries no state.

control.$description: Input and control boundaries. ≥ 3:1 against panel and raised (WCAG 1.4.11, NHIS A20).

focus.$description: Focus ring. Achromatic so it never reads as an alert. ≥ 3:1 against every surface and alert fill boundary.

focusHalo.$description: Inner offset ring so focus stays visible on light fills.

interactive.$description: Achromatic. Colour is reserved for coded meaning (NHIS A1, A28; Few 2007 'mostly grey'). Selection and emphasis use luminance, weight and shape.

status.$description: Reserved safety semantics. Red/yellow/blue appear only here (and hazard striping). Safety red is never a text colour: it is a fill behind light text or a stroke/shape (FAA AC 25-11B 5.8.7 'avoid red on black'; NHIS A28, B22). Emergency and Warning share red values but are separate tokens so they can never be merged in code.

source.ref: NHIS A1, A2, A28; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 App. F F.5.10
source.status: P (exact NASA colour values in Tables F.5-1/F.5-2 not read: U)

nhis.note: Hex values are NHIS design decisions within NASA's red/yellow/blue semantics, not NASA-specified values.

text.$description: Nominal is quiet and achromatic. There is no 'green = OK' code.

emergency.$description: Reserved authorized operational class. Same red as Warning (NASA App. F); distinguished by label, glyph, annunciation, critical overlay and hierarchy, never by colour.

data.$description: Data quality is a separate dimension from alert priority (03 §20). Achromatic on purpose: degraded data is shown by label, glyph, dashed outline and hatching, not by a new colour or by greying it out.

degradedText.$description: Stale values stay fully legible: the last value is shown, marked, never hidden or faded (A7, A31).

degradedStroke.$description: Dashed outline around stale, delayed, unknown and unavailable values.

hatch.$description: Hatch pattern stroke for stale regions and data gaps.

mode.$description: Simulation, training and what-if must never be confused with live operation (NHIS A9; NASA App. F F.4.1). Violet is the one non-alert coding colour.

hazard.$description: Black-and-yellow striping for critical, hazardous or irreversible commands (NHIS A10; NASA App. F F.4.3.2).

viz.$description: Chart colours. Series are separated by line style and labels, not hue (NHIS A2, A28).

historical.$description: Historical series; drawn thinner than live.

limitCaution.$description: Limit line for a Caution limit supplied by an approved source. NHIS never invents limits.

limitWarning.$description: Limit line for a Warning limit supplied by an approved source.

brand.$description: Logo surfaces only. The supplied logo keeps its native red inside the artwork; that red is not an interface token (00 §NASTRA Brand Asset Authority).

logoBackground.$description: The supplied logo's leaf and star are white: it requires a dark ground.

eva.$description: EVA visor simulation colours. On an additive see-through display black renders as transparent; 'background' here means the scene, not a surface.

textGreen.$description: Monochrome-green rendering for B5 review and green-only optics (Joint AR ConOps).

plate.$description: Tight backing plate behind peripheral text only (NHIS B23). Does not assume a plate darkens the scene on real optics.

alertFill.$description: Red only as a filled shape behind white text (B22).

type.$description: Typography roles (03 §7). Mixed case everywhere; no all-caps body or labels (HIMSS 2009 via NHIS A22). Mono is used only where numeric alignment matters.

label.$description: Field labels, units, data-age, alert record fields. Never below 12 pt (A21).

meta.$description: Tertiary metadata only (e.g. chart axis ticks, secondary history columns). 10.5 pt, above the 9 pt floor.

telemetryPrimary.$description: Primary telemetry value in a vital tile. Toward NASA's preferred 0.4° at 600 mm.

controlDefault.$description: Default control height: touch toward WCAG 2.5.5 (44 px) where Station has touch (NHIS A30).

controlCompact.$description: Dense lists and tables, pointer use. Above the 24 px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum.

glyphAlert.$description: Alert glyph inside banners and records.

stationViewportMinWidth.$description: Minimum supported Station viewport (laptop). Overview must fit without scrolling (A26).

control.$description: Disciplined geometry: small radii, no pill shapes.

motion.$description: Motion communicates state, transition or urgency only (00 §11). Nominal UI is still. Reduced motion sets durations to 0 and replaces flashing with a steady high-emphasis treatment.

feedback.$description: Press/selection feedback within 0.1 s (NN/g; NHIS A29).

flash.$description: Alert flashing. Reserved for events needing immediate attention; stops on acknowledgement; crew can stop it; never more than 3 flashes per second. Applied to the alert glyph only (small area, under WCAG 2.3.1 general flash area). Synchronised by one shared clock (NASA App. F).

source.ref: NHIS A27, B28; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 App. F F.5.11; WCAG 2.3.1

periodMs.$description: 3 Hz, at the WCAG 2.3.1 ceiling. Glyph only.

station.$description: A stop control must exist for flashing over 5 s (NHIS A27; WCAG 2.2.2). Acknowledge and Suppress both stop flashing.

audio.$description: Audio vocabulary: identifiers and constraints only. NHIS does not invent tones (NHIS operational alert model). Values for real tones come from the applicable source.

emergency.$description: Distinct from Warning. Source-defined tone and/or speech.

preAlertAttenuationDb.$description: First sounding 10 dB below the final level (NHIS A4).

toneRangeHz.$description: Alert tones between 200 Hz and 4 kHz (NHIS A4).

z.$description: Layering. Emergency sits above everything; tooltips never cover alerts or the focused control.

sticky.$description: Mission header. Uses scroll-padding so it never hides focus (WCAG 2.4.11).

eva.$description: EVA layout and legibility in visual angle (03 §12.2). These are NHIS starting values for suited or analog testing, not flight limits (01 Checklist B).

clearZoneRadius.$description: Central clear zone over the line of sight, extending down over the foot-placement region. No persistent non-conformal content.

alertNearLosMax.$description: Warning cue within ±15° of line of sight.

warningMinAreaSqDeg.$description: Time-critical warning at least 2 square degrees (NHIS B6).

peripheryBelowHorizonMax.$description: Persistent status preferred 0–35° below the horizon (NHIS B25).

sustainedReadingAboveHorizonMax.$description: No sustained reading more than 10° above the horizon (NHIS B25).

textPrimary.$description: Primary glanced value: 0.6–0.8° (NHIS B20). 0.7° chosen mid-range.

textStationaryFloor.$description: Absolute floor for secondary labels read while stationary (NHIS B20).

displayDiagonalFov.$description: Simulation assumption from candidate displays (36–38°, Mitra et al. 2023). Not a hardware specification.

dwellRevealMs.$description: Gaze dwell for reversible reveal only; never commits (NHIS B31). D; desktop study: U.

glanceSingleMs.$description: Single status read ≤ 2 s (NHIS B18, automotive upper bound).

glanceCumulativeMs.$description: Full suit-state check ≤ 12 s cumulative (NHIS B18).

minFrameRate.$description: Frame rate holds at 60 fps (NHIS B27).

maxProtocolSteps.$description: At most four steps; only the current step at full intensity (NHIS B17).

lowlight.$description: Lowlighted (not removed) items not relevant to the current step (NHIS B14). Design decision; needs optical test.

component.$description: Layer C. Only where a component needs constrained local tuning.

emergencyRing.$description: Double ring around the Emergency overlay and glyph; one of its non-colour distinctions from Warning.

outlineWidth.$description: Outline that leaves terrain visible (NHIS B6).

nominalOpacity.$description: Nominal vitals lowlighted, raised by exception (NHIS B13).
